goal: Remove contract-to-implementation reverse dependencies without changing v1 wire or persisted shapes.
guardrails: Do not move runtime validators/defaults/effectful descriptors into implementation/contracts.
Do not change public wire fields, durable JSON, error codes, or crash ordering as part of this cleanup.
Do not replace one reverse dependency with another src/* type import from contracts.
Do not reintroduce a contract -> implementation type reference; the architecture rule now expects zero planned aliases.

completed.note: All four reverse dependencies removed. Capability, ResourceLimits and ProtocolLimits are now declared by their contract owners, with the runtime descriptors checked against them in both directions at compile time. The Transaction alias was removed rather than replaced: StorePort.transaction takes a zero-argument callback, nothing in src/ or the ports consumed the contract's Transaction, so introducing a port would have added an abstraction with no consumer.
